instruction:
Coworking Retrofit IFC, Revit Room Schedule CSV, And Plan Sheet PDF

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc and uses the local reference image C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png. In Revit, modify the starting model into a coworking layout, export the model as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, export a Revit room area schedule as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv, and export a one-page Revit plan sheet as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf; C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is at least 20 bytes, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf is at least 200 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 8 IfcSpace entities, 4 IfcWall entities, and 1 IfcSlab.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities.
6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token reception at least once, open office at least once, meeting at least 4 times, pantry at least once, and toilet at least once.
7. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is a Revit room schedule export with exactly the headers Room Name,Area in that order and exactly 8 non-empty data rows.
8. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv contains these exact room name and area rows: Reception=14.0, Open Office=87.75, Meeting Room 1=19.5, Meeting Room 2=19.5, Meeting Room 3=19.5, Meeting Room 4=20.15, Pantry=12.8, and Accessible Toilet=6.8.
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains exactly 1 page exported from a Revit sheet.
10. The extracted text from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains the case-insensitive tokens COWORKING PLAN and Main plan sheet.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
